(ga)༄༅/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi gsang spyod mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga las bzhi rnam gsal me long zhes

tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi gsang spyod mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga las bzhi rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpag yas thugs rje'i zhugs lce brkyangs pa'i khar// sdig sgrib bar chad bud shing yongs zos nas// dngos grub 'dod dgu'i g.yos legs dga' ston mkhan// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gros dge legs stsol// ye shes lus phra'i zhal lung grub dbang las// rim brgyud zab don spyod kyi mkha' 'gro lnga'i// phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzugs brnyan rab gsal ba'i// sreg blugs cho ga'i me long rnam par bskrun// bsgom bzlas brtson pa mi dman gsus khyim du// byin rlabs nus pa'i dag byed yongs btung nas// phrin las chu rgyun chad pa med skyugs pa'i// rig sngags 'chang gi drang srong de rmad byung*// tshul 'di'i sbyor ba thab dang yo byad bsham// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed phal mchog me lha mchod// rjes ni mchod cing bzod par gsol te gshegs// bkra shis dbyangs kyis mtha' mar brgyan bya'o// zhes pa ltar las thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sbyor ba la gnyis kyi dang po thab ni sa stegs mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas khru phyed kyis zlum por bskor/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa gnyis kyis bskor ba kha sgyer dang mu ran/ tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa nas zur bzhir mtshan ma btsal te/ stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/ mu ran la rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad tshon dmar skyas bya/ thab kyi nang gi sum gcig lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis padma 'dab brgyad phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ dbang ldan sngo/ bden bral ljang gu/ lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la lha so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung dgod do// gnyis pa yo byad bsham pa ni/

kha sgyer gyi steng du bud shing 'jam po'am srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po zlum por brtsig de'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can dkar po bsham/ thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar me yol pha gu la dkar zhal gyis byugs pa dang*/ stegs kyi khar rdo rje dang dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar dang blugs gzar kha sbyar ba dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang nang mchod rnams bsham/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs nas rim par yam shing 'o ma can gyi rigs brgya rtsa dang nyer gcig pa'am bdun tshan gnyis/ mar khu/ til lam yungs kar/ phye mar dang dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams bsham/ g.yon logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ 'das gtor dang me lha'i gtor ma gnyis bsham mo// dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang por bdag bskyed pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus la sogs par zhwa gos dkar pos brgyan te kha shar du phyogs te skyil krung ngam rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam dang rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas 'khod de/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub thabs skyabs su 'gro ba nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i rjes su 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams la/ rang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i nga rgyal du gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ thog mar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas gzhag 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bslab bo// de nas rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes dpal 'bar sbar ba lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas thab la g.yas nas zlum por lan gsum du bskor zhing*/

ngag tu/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki sogs mkha' 'gro lnga'i sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra dzwā la raṃ zhes brjod cing me tshang du gzhug la rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas me sbar/ de nas dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung nas blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg pas mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ badzra dzwā la raṃ zhes pas me gso/ skabs 'dir me bkra brtag la ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing nang mchod nas gtor/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas rdzas rnams la gtor la/ a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ bud shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās sbyangs te byin gyis brlab bo// thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor la/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par bsam/ thab kyi dbus su me dkar gsal rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las me lha ra skyes la chibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/

lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha la drang srong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya las mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab sbyar ba dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgyas rna ba'i drung du g.yob cing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ agni ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha kaḥ/ kā ru ṇya kṛ ta sarba artha asminsanni hi to bha ba/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngar ltar spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/

oṃ badzra sa twa a zhes brjod cing*/ thab kyi mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsams te/ oṃ agna ye swā hā zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar dgang blugs gnyis kha sbyar la/ oṃ agna ye a dī pyā di pyā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swā hā zhes pas me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas gzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de'ang oṃ agna ye zhes pa'i mtshan sngags lan re sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā zhes pas yam shing lan bdun nam nyer gcig phul mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swā hā zhes gdags/ sbyin bdag gi don du bya ba'i tshe spel tshig kha bsgyur shes par bya'o// de bzhin du/ oṃ agna ye swā hās mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya swā hās til lam yungs kar dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so ba dang*/

oṃ badzra puṣṭā ye swā hās 'bras dang*/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūrba dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hās ku sha ste/ sde tshan re re'i 'gor mtshan sngags dang mthar spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar la phul ba'i mthar mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul te/ oṃ badzra dzwā la raṃ zhes dang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klod du srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser ba sogs nas las kyi mkha' 'gro la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing brjod/ gtso mo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha dad ma yin par dmigs la/ gzar bu gnyis blangs te/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje sogs sngar bzhin brjod la/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki sogs mkha' 'gro lnga'i sngags lan gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ agna ye swā hā lan bdun gyis mar phul mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar te/ a dī pyā di pyā sogs dang bdag gis tshe 'khor ba sogs spel tshig gong bzhin brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya bcas te mchod pa rnams/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pañtsa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes sogs nas shabda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

zhe sdang rnam dag sogs bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams bya'o// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar lha sngags lan re sngon du 'gro ba'i rdzas sngags so sos brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar spel tshig gong bzhin bya'o// de'ang*/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du ste/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu'o// yam shing 'bar ba'i 'od la 'bul// ku sha dūrba gtsug tor la'o// de nas til mdun du bzhag pa la bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa thim/ slar ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ til sngags brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i til 'bul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi mar dang yam shing gis me rgyun gso/ slar yang byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa nyer spyod byin rlabs bsreg rdzas dor ba ma gtogs sngar ltar byas la/ gong ltar mchod pa'am/ spro na/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// zhes pa la mchod yon gyi tshab tu me tog la sogs pa kha bsgyur ba dang bcas te mtshan sngags spel ba'i arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ gtor ma dang po chab kyis bran la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung sogs nas ha ho hrīḥ'i bar tshogs ltar ram/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dkyus ltar phul nas mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/

thab kyi thal ba nas srin lag gis cung zad blangs pa dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rjes la gnyis kyi dang po mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwā la raṃ zhes dang*/ slar yang 'bar ba me lha'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa phul mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul la/ me lha'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā zhes sogs gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad du gyur pa'i nyes pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhus/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga 'khrul pa dang*/ yo byad dman pa la sogs pa skyon du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod do// gnyis pa gshegs gsol bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa ni/ sngar gyi dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed cing*// bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ agni gatstsha zhes dang*/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrungs la/

dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi cho gas mtha' brgyan/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ni me ma mnal gyi bar mi bsgul/ me mnal ba dang thal ba phyags la chu klung ngam ri rtse la sogs par dor ro// dkar gsal me 'od stong phrag 'bar ba'i klong*// lha tshogs sreg blugs mgron du gnyer byas pa// de nyid nas brtsams mthun pa min pa'i phyogs// mtha' dag zhi ba sngags kyi zab khyad yin// zhi ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //de nyid gzhir bzhag tshe dpal bsod nams sogs// rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i spun zla ru// sgrub byed rgyas pa'i las kyi sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i me long ngos su gsal// gnyis pa rang gzhan gyi don du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs yangs par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas khru gang gi tshad kyis phyogs bzhir mtshan ma byas la/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma'i steng bzung nas g.yas pas zur bzhi'i thig la mtshan ma btsal/ de'i steng thig bzhi btab pas thab rang dang*/ slar yang de'i steng sor brgyad pa gnyis gnyis bskyed pa'i mtshan ma btsal te thig gnyis re btab pas kha sgyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ thab nang gi sum gcig zlum por bskor ba lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis bskor bas padma 'dab brgyad bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog ser po la bcad tshon li khris bya/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba bri/ lha gnas su tshom bu'am tshon spungs bya/ gnyis pa yo byad ni/ kha sgyer gyi steng nas bud shing 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim po dbus kyi cha las byung ba'am/ med na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po gru bzhir brtsigs/

shar lhor me tshang dang*/ lhor sgrub pa po'i gdan sogs bsham/ g.yas logs nas yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing sbom phra gung mo tsam srid du khru gang pa/ rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ mar dang*/ 'o mar phye mngar gsum sogs sbags pa'i zas mchog til/ so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams sam/ bsdu na/ yam shing*/ mar/ zas mchog dūrba ste bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo de tsam kyang chog par bshad/ g.yon logs nas mchod gtor rnams sngar bzhin bsham mo// dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid gos rgyan ser pos brgyan te rang gzhan gyi tshe bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas par byas te tshim pa'i bsam pas/ kha byang du phyogs par sa 'ja' li la sogs par khyil 'dug gis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bslab/ dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas nas bskor ba sogs nas/ dgang gzar khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis brkyangs pa'am/ rtse sbyar ba'i rin chen khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams 'dra/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i thab khung ser po rgyar khru gnyis pa/ zabs su khru gang pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// phal pa'i me lha'i skabs/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba zhes dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ bdag gam sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sogs gdags pa ma gtogs 'dra/ gsum pa mchog gi me lha'i skabs gtso 'khor thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/

zhes dang*/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod ces pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i spel tshig ni bdag dang sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams sogs brjod pa dang*/ go rim til gyi gong du zas mchog 'ong ba ma gtogs 'dra/ grangs brgya rtsa brgyad dang rdzas kyi gtso bo zas mchog la grangs bzung ba dang*/ spel tshig min pa gzhan gong ma dang 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa tsam las gzhan thams cad zhi ba ltar bya'o// las rab rgyas pa'i dpag bsam yongs 'du las// sde bzhi'i 'bras bu 'byin phyir mi 'dud par// log 'tsho'i tsher skam yal ga 'dzings pa la// kha gsags lag pa rkyong rnams e ma blun// rgyas pa'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //zhi byed cho ga bzhir bzhag brtan g.yo'i dngos// ma lus dga' ba'i snying thag la 'khyud de// rang dbang 'gugs byed las kyi sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i me long ngos su gsal// gsum pa rang gzhan gyi don du dbang gi sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs la thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum 'phags pa'i sar thab dbus kyis mtshan ma byas la khru phyed kyi tshad kyis/ g.yon pas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i steng bzung*/ g.yas pas me nas dbang ldan gyi thig la reg par g.yas skor du bskor/ slar yang de'i khar sor bzhi bzhi bskyed la lan gnyis bskor bas kha sgyer dang mu ran te shar gyi thig rtse so sor sbrel ba'i thig btab pas zla gam gyi dbyibs 'byung*/

nub kyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor phrad pa nas dbus bar gyi tshad des zur bzhir mtshan ma byas pa'i steng nas thig gru bzhir btab/ de'i khar yang sor bzhi bskyed la zur bzhir mtshan ma dang thig btab pas thab stegs so// thab nang padma sogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ gzhi tshon dmar po la bcad tshon dkar pos bya/ kha sgyer mu ran gang rung la lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan par bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad ni/ bud shing ni yam shing skabs ltar ram/ med na nags kyi lci bas zla gam du brtsig shar du sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can sogs 'dra/ rang gi g.yas logs nas/ yam shing seng ldeng*/ mdzo mo shing*/ se ba/ shug pa sogs dmar po rtsi ma nyams pa rked pa'i cha las byung ba/ sbom phra sor mo tsam dang srid du chag do pa/ mar ni smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba tsha ba'i mar khu cung zad bsres pa/ rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog dmar po'am/ 'bras dmar po/ med pa na tsandan dmar po sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ gzhan zas mchog til sogs 'dra/ g.yon nas gi wang*/ gur gum/ tsandan dmar po sogs btab pa'i mchod yon/ chu gtsang gi zhal bsil sogs nyer spyod/ gtor ma dmar por bya/ dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ phyi dro'i dus su gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan te/ rgyal po dang yul 'khor dang*/ paṇḍi ta la sogs pa dbang du byed pa dang chags shing 'dun pa'i bsam pas kha nub tu bltas te padma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ nang mchod byin rlabs nas/ me ni rgyal po'am smad 'tshong ma'am chang 'tshong ma'am/ btso blag mkhan gyi me'am/ kun du rgyus lam du bus pa'i mes bya/ dgang gzar blugs khu tshur bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub padma'i 'dab ltar byas pa padma'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba ma gtogs 'dra/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgyar khru gang pa/

zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha sgyer ram mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng bas mtshan pa sogs 'dra/ me lha gzhan 'dra ba la/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba zhes dang*/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ rgyal po dang yul 'khor dang*/ paṇḍi ta la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes gdags pa ma gtogs 'dra/ gsum pa mchog gi me lha'i skabs gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes dang*/ lha thams cad chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇḍi ta la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad chags shing 'dun pa'i las mdzad ces pa dang dbang gi spel tshig gdags pa dang*/ grangs lnga bcu dang rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog dmar po la grangs bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol zhes pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan thams cad zhi ba dang 'dra bar bya'o// dbang byed las kyi lang tsho dar babs mas// srid zhi'i khengs ldan snying gi brtan pa dag /yongs su nyams nas rgya skyegs kyis dmar gdong*// mdzes sdug 'bum gyis lta byed 'di rmad byung*// dbang gi sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //dang po gzhir byas chos dang rnal 'byor sogs// sdang mig dmar por lta ba'i gdug can rnams// rtswa sbun bzhin du za byed sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i me long ngos su gsal// bzhi pa bstan pa rin po che sogs la sdang zhing mtho 'tsham pa'i dgra bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs tshar gcad pa'i phyir drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/

sa chog byas pa'i sa gzhir thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas sor drug dang sor mo gcig gi sum gnyis kyi tshad kyis zlum por lan gnyis bskor/ de'i phyir sor drug pa gnyis kyis lan gnyis bskor/ zlum skor gnyis pa dang byang gi tshangs thig 'dzom par g.yon pas srad bu bzung*/ de dang lte ba'i bar gyi tshad des shar nub kyi zlum skor la rtags bya/ byang ngos su de gnyis sbrel ba'i thig btab/ de gnyis dang lho'i tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzom par sbrel ba'i thig btab pas gru gsum 'byung ba thab nang dang*/ zlum skor phyi ma gnyis kyi steng nas kyang de ltar byas nas thig btab pas kha sgyer dang mu ran 'byung ngo*// zlum skor phyi ma'i tshad kyis phyi rol du thab stegs gru bzhir gdab/ nang gi zlum skor dang po'i sum gnyis pad 'dab dang sum gcig gis lte ba bya/ thab kyi gzhi tshon thams cad kha dog nag po la bcad tshon sngo skyas bya/ kha sgyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa bri/ gnyis pa yo byad bsham pa ni/ kha sgyer gyi steng nas bud shing tsher ma can dang gzhan yang bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs la sogs pas gru gsum du brtsig nang du me tshang gi ting lo bzhag byang du sgrub pa po'i stan sogs nas ku sha'i chun po bar 'dra/ de'i g.yas logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod gtor ma gnyis/ g.yon logs nas yam shing drag po'i shing nag cing 'khyog pa dri mi zhim pa rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam dang srid sor bcu pa drug cu lhag bcas dang*/ nyer gcig pa'am bdun pa tshan gcig mar ram tsha ba'i mar khu/ sha sna/ khrag sna/ dug sna/ ske tshe/ yungs kar/ yungs nag gzhan yang til nag zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ bro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams sam/ bsdu na/ yam shing*/ mar/ sha khrag sogs khyad par gyi rdzas de gsum tsam gyis chog pa'ang bshad/

dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ nyin phyed dang mtshan phyed kyi dus su gos rgyan nag pos brgyan te/ bgegs la sogs pa tshar bcad pa'i bsam pas kha lhor phyogs par rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'am/ yang na g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung gi spyod lam gyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni mdun gyi nang mchod byin rlabs sogs 'dra/ me ni gdol pa'am shan pa'i khyim gyi me'am rdo'am lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun pa'i gru gsum du g.yon nas lan gsum bskor zhing*/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i sngags dang oṃ badzra dzwā la raṃ zhes brjod cing me sbar ba dang*/ dgang blugs rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcang*/ mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i khro bo'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas me gso ba ma gtogs mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa rnams 'dra'o// thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung nag po zur gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pa'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa sogs dang 'dra/ thab kyi nang du me dmar nag rab tu 'bar ba'i sogs dang*/ me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar nag las 'od zer nag po 'phro ba zhes dang*/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa dang*/ khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang gzar bzung ba dang*/ khyad par gyi rdzas la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā zhes pas 'bul zhing spel tshig agna ye sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la mtho 'tsham pa'i dgra bgegs zhes sam/ gdon bgegs la sogs pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu skabs su gang bab bsgyur ba ma gtogs me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i bar gyis phal ba'i me lha bskyed cing mchod pa 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha'i skabs gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes dang*/

lha thams cad nag cing rab tu khros pa 'od zer nag po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad par gyur zhes pa lta bu dang*/ khyad par gyi rdzas mkha' 'gro lnga'i sngags brjod cing lag pa g.yon pas 'bul/ go rim til gyi gong du sha khrag sogs khyad par rdzas 'ong ba ma gtogs 'dra/ grangs drug cu dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo sha khrag sogs la grangs bzung ba dang*/ drag po'i spel tshig sbyar ba min pa gzhan dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam pa'i bar gyi mchog gi me lha bskyed cing mchod de gshegs su gsol ba'i bar thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa/ rdo rje slob dpon la mtho 'tsham pa/ sems can mang po la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sam/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la mtho 'tsham zhing chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol zhes pa tsam ma gtogs bkra shis kyi cho gas mthar brgyan pa'i bar gyi rjes kyi chos rnams zhi ba 'dra bar bya'o// thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la zhi ba la 'o ma dang*/ rgyas pa la gur gum gyi chu dang*/ dbang la tsandan dmar po'i chu dang*/ drag po la dug chus me bsad la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs la bkra shis kyi me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// tsheg sgra stong phrag 'bar ba'i me dpung klong*// lha tshogs sdang mig gzigs pa'i g.yar lam du// dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog rtsa rdo rje'i khams// grub kyang skad cig gnyis par tshugs sam ci// drag po'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //smras pa/ gnyis skyes mchod sbyin byed par ma skyes shing*// me yi mig can grogs su bkug min par// mi mthun phyogs 'joms gsang ba sngags kyi me// sbor ba'i tshul la mkhas 'di bla ma'i drin// mi mthun phyogs 'joms legs pa'i phyogs bskyed pa'i// las rab mthu 'di ma rdzogs ni ru ka

/rang mtshang sgrib phyir rgod ma'i brtul zhugs kyis// chu gter chen po'i 'gram du nyul ba bzhin// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge bas yang srid kun// srid gsum sdug bsngal bud shing sreg byed pa'i// ye shes snang ba mi zad stobs bdo bas// kun mkhyen phrin las rgyas par byed gyur cig /ces grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi gsang spyod mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga las bzhi rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos tshul 'di'i rnal 'byor pa rab 'byams bsod nams brtan pas bskul ngor/ kun mkhyen chos rje'i gsung don dang*/ shong chen ri khrod pas mdzad pa'i sgrub skor sogs la brten nas nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis/ 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i rgyun chen po dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa bi dza yantu/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
